rationale: S-0059-03 proposes a synapse-count scaling sweep on the t0059 substrate (100 -> 200 -> 300 E + I) to break the single-spike regime and test the structural-drive hypothesis. The from-scratch family (t0052 - t0059) has been deprioritised. Bed B (deRosenroll 2026, t0024) already operates with > 1000 SAC varicosities by design — the structural-drive question is naturally answered by the deposited substrate without needing to scale up the from-scratch family. Rejecting as stale.
